About Bahrain National Day

Bahrain celebrates National Day and Accession Day on 16 and 17 December.

Frequently asked questions

When is Bahrain National Day 2026?

Wednesday 16 December 2026, with the holiday on 16 and 17 December.

Is National Day a private-sector holiday in Bahrain?

Yes, 16 and 17 December are paid official holidays; working on them earns extra pay or a substitute day.

  • Bahrain — Labour Law 36/2012 (Legislation and Legal Opinion Commission, Arabic)
